text_layer.note: The text the 2026-08-19 negative search could not find: the Old Russian of all seven books (Meshcherskii 1958, 37/01), the German of Books I–IV (Berendts–Grass 1924–1927, 37/02), the English of the twenty-two additions (Thackeray 1928, 37/03) and Eisler's rendering and case (1929–1930, 37/04). This seat stays the index of the eight passages. On 2026-11-12 the index was repaired to the received eight, and the AXN was re-derived (see axn_prior).
text_layer.first_statement: Berendts 1906 (37/05), who first argued in the West that the Slavonic preserves Josephus's first, Aramaic edition; his Zacharias and John apocrypha (1895, 1904) are 37/06–37/07.
text_layer.the_challenger: Robert Eisler (1882–1949): ΙΗΣΟΥΣ ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥΣ (37/04), The Messiah Jesus (37/08), the Testimonium answer to Bienert (37/09), with Orpheus the Fisher, The Enigma of the Fourth Gospel and Weltenmantel und Himmelszelt (37/10–37/12).
